name: CartDrawer
deprecation_reason: CartDrawer is retained only for legacy pages; new pages must use the Cart V2 profile.
usage_hint: DEPRECATED (Cart V1). Use Cart V2 instead: set head.use_cart_v2: true and the renderer injects the resolved cart profile automatically. CartDrawer remains only for legacy pages that already use it.
when_to_use: NEVER on new pages — set head.use_cart_v2: true instead. Only keep CartDrawer when editing an existing legacy page that already contains it and the store has not enabled Cart V2.
when_not_to_use: Any new page. Any page with head.use_cart_v2: true (conflict — publish validation rejects it). Any store with cart_v2 enabled.
combine_with: Legacy pages only. For new pages: head.use_cart_v2 plus a published cart profile.
anti_patterns: Using CartDrawer on a new page: deprecated — Cart V2 (use_cart_v2: true) is the default cart
Adding CartDrawer to a use_cart_v2 page: dual cart surfaces, publish validation fails
Multiple CartDrawer instances: creates state conflicts

examples.label: DEPRECATED — do not use on new pages. Cart V2 equivalent shown for migration reference
